text:
maia: Q2 OKR checkpoint — contrast checklist for milestone delivery. quick TL;DR: model-routing canary shipped, embeddings latency work slipped one sprint, autoscale infra delayed. listing owners/blocks and next actions below.

samir: canary is live for europe region (50% traffic). metrics look ok but p99 tail still up for 1024+ tokens. will post chart later. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

deploy-bot: canary-deploy-1719208000: completed on eu-cluster-2 (2/3 targets), fallback policy active.

alex: I shipped the routing policy change and the new fallback rules. verified on staging. no API changes.

ciara: embeddings latency task (OBJ-EMB-12) slipped. blocked by quantization testing — TPU build failed for v1.2. Need eng-ml help to triage.

jordan: eng-infra rolling kernel update is blocking TPU test image — ETA Weds EOD. I can prioritize but need approval for node reboot window.

samir: next steps for p99 tail: add KV-prefetch hook + smaller batch cap for long sequences. I can PR today but will need a quick CR. @alex can you review?

alex: yes, I can review after standup. please add unit test and perf script.

ciara: for embeddings, can we ship a temporary Q=8 quantized variant to unblock customers while we finish QA? tradeoff doc: slightly lower quality but 40% cost savings.

maia: Product agrees to short-lived Q=8 flag behind feature gate if eng signs off. need clear rollback criteria and customer comms.

jordan: re: autoscale, image rollout + kernel window are the blocks. proposed rollout plan: 1) kernel patch on canaries 2) image bake 3) phased rolling update over 48h. want to avoid large capacity loss.

samir: owner clarifications: samir -> routing perf work, alex -> routing infra rules & CR, jordan -> infra rollout & kernel, ciara -> embeddings QA and customer comms.

maia: dependency matrix (compact):
- routing perf: depends on infra kernel patch (jordan) and alex CR
- embeddings QA: depends on eng-ml quant tests + infra image (ciara/jordan)
- autoscale: depends on image bake and cluster evict policy (jordan)

ciara: ask list:
- eng-ml: triage TPU build logs and rerun quant test (assign: rachel?)
- eng-infra: approve 2h reboot window on Wed for canary nodes
- docs: short comms note for customers if we flip Q=8 flag

alex: I can draft the ops rollback steps and CR checklist. will link PR when ready.

maia: deadlines:
- routing PR + review: today EOD
- infra kernel patch canary: Wed EOD
- embeddings Q=8 short flag decision: Thurs AM
- autoscale phased rollout start: Fri morning (if kernel patch passes)

samir: quick risk callout — if p99 tail persists after KV-prefetch, we may need to throttle long-seq requests which affects SLA. flagging to support team.

ciara: customer comms draft will be ready Thurs noon, will include rollback criteria and expected perf change.

deploy-bot: incident-monitor: no active incidents. 1 open alert on eu-cluster p99 memory spike (investigating).

jordan: I'll sync with infra ops now and escalate reboot window if needed. will update thread.

maia: thanks all — please update this thread as you make progress. I'll consolidate into the Q2 milestone log after Friday. :thumbsup:
